parameters.jsCode: const r=$input.first().json||{};const rows=r.rows||r.input?.rows||[];const cfg=r.config||r.input?.config||{};if(!Array.isArray(rows)) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C5-B',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'ROWS_NOT_ARRAY',message:'rows must be an array.'},next_action:'provide_rows'}}];const allow=new Set(cfg.allowed_fields||[]);if(!allow.size) return [{json:{success:false,component_id:'C5-B',component_version:'v1',error:{code:'NO_ALLOWED_FIELDS',message:'config.allowed_fields is required to avoid accidental data exposure.'},next_action:'configure_visibility'}}];const visible=rows.filter(x=>cfg.client_id==null||x.client_id===cfg.client_id).map(x=>Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(x).filter(([k])=>allow.has(k))));return [{json:{success:true,component_id:'C5-B',component_version:'v1',portal_table:{rows:visible,count:visible.length,allowed_fields:[...allow]},next_action:'render_client_portal',error:null}}];
